notes.note: Reviewed the composer geometry repair: displayableProjectIcon selects 18px for valid chosen icons and ProjectIcon size24 for its existing half-size 12px fallback dot. Missing and invalid legacy remote icons keep the prior dot geometry; both Home and dock use the same component, with no remote image request or identity/selection change. The existing composition keeper now checks actual rendered inline geometry for valid image/glyph and bare/invalid-icon cases. On unchanged source it failed exactly the two dot cases (9px received versus 12px required); after repair all49 tests passed. The hosted0dda838 Gallery capture completed54/54 and isolated the prior3px shrink to two chip regions; a new-head Gallery capture has not run, so pixel restoration is not claimed. Current guide icon/colour and start/selection descriptions remain accurate; no prose or shared reference assets changed.
